description: Completes a partial name as the person types: places, neighborhoods, categories, collections, mayor roles for gathering spots and events, and business records whose names start with the text (or have a word that starts with it). Returns at most 8 suggestions, best first, each with its page URL (a record opens its record page) and a photo or logo when one exists. For a full ranked search with filters, call search.

limit.description: How many suggestions, default and most 8.

q.description: The text typed so far, for example "leo" or "bay v".

name: suggest
